opennyai_summary.facts:
By way of the captioned writ petition, the petitioner has challenged an order dated 24.08.2023, by which her services were sought to be terminated by respondent No. 2 - Chief Executive Officer, Food Safety and Standards Authority of India ["FSSAI"], and also seeks a direction upon FSSAI to regularise her services.
An interim order was passed on 29.08.2023, restraining her termination.
2. By way of the present application, FSSAI seeks vacation of that order.
opennyai_summary.arguments: It is contended that, under the protection of the said interim order, the writ petitioner is not attending to her duties and has been unauthorisedly absent for inordinate periods of time.

opennyai_summary.decision:
Having regard to the above, the application is disposed of, with the clarification that the interim order dated 29.08.2023 does not come in the way of FSSAI from initiating disciplinary proceedings against the petitioner for any alleged misconduct.
However, in the event the FSSAI proposes to terminate her services, it shall approach this Court before effecting such termination.
